title: In the Potter's Hands
story:
A young apprentice watched a master potter at work.

The potter placed a lump of clay on the spinning wheel.

His hands gently pressed and shaped it.

Sometimes he added water.

Sometimes he applied more pressure.

The apprentice asked,

“Why do you keep changing its shape?”

The potter smiled.

“I am not trying to ruin it.

I am helping it become what I designed it to be.”

After some time, the clay became a beautiful vase.

It was stronger and more useful than before.

In life, we may not always understand why God allows certain changes or challenges.

But like the potter, He knows exactly what He is creating.

His hands never leave us.

Every moment of shaping has a purpose.

When we trust Him, our lives become a beautiful reflection of His design.
life_lesson: Trust the Potter. God is shaping your life with wisdom, love, and purpose.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being the Potter and for never giving up on me.

When Your shaping is difficult to understand, help me to trust Your loving hands.

Mold my heart to become more like Christ.

Use my life for Your glory.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there an area of your life where God may be shaping you?

Are you resisting His work or trusting His hands?

How can you surrender more fully to His purpose today?
